summary: Leonida Fishing v2 feature fully verified: SQL logic (32/32 ok=t), unit tests (64/64), typecheck clean, and all 8 UI acceptance criteria covered with mocked Playwright checks. Existing Neoshop vehicle-design regressions re-verified (pass). No bugs found; one minor finding (not a bug) noted below.

checks.criterion: SQL server logic for odds, bait boost, prices, uses, daily limit, Berlin reset, no double rewards
checks.name: sqltest-run.sh (013,016,018,019,022,023,024,025,027,028) + yarn test
checks.evidence: bash scripts/sqltest/run.sh ... -> 32 rows, all ok=t (PASS). `yarn test` -> vitest run: all suites passed including src/lib/fishing.test.ts (64 tests total, 0 failures). `cd frontend && yarn typecheck` -> tsc --noEmit clean, exit 0.

checks.criterion: Fishing game screen on iPhone viewport
checks.name: fishing-screen-layout-iphone
checks.evidence: 390x844 viewport, mocked logged-in session + my_fishing_state RPC. Verified fishing-attempts chip '4/15', fishing-active-bait chip '2/3', cast/bait/collection buttons visible, coin balance visible, no horizontal scroll (scrollWidth<=clientWidth).

checks.name: fishing-cast-bite-reel-flow-mocked
checks.evidence: start_fishing_cast called once on tap; status shows 'Bite' text during wait; after bite_delay, reel button (force-clicked to bypass CSS pulse-animation actionability stall) called reel_fishing_cast exactly once with _reel:true; result card showed '+250' coins and gold-spark legendary elements.

checks.name: fishing-missed-bite-mocked
checks.evidence: Cast started, reel button never tapped; after window expired client auto-called reel_fishing_cast with _reel:false exactly once; result card 'fishing-result-escaped' showed 'The fish got away!' text.

checks.name: fishing-daily-limit-reached-mocked
checks.evidence: Mocked used=15/limit=15: fishing-attempts shows '15/15', cast button disabled, fishing-limit-message shows "You've used all 15 fishing attempts for today. Come back tomorrow!"; forced click on disabled button did not call start_fishing_cast (0 calls).

checks.name: fishing-bait-sheet-selection-mocked
checks.evidence: Opened sheet shows 'Ohne Köder'-equivalent (none) option + bait options; owned common bait shows '2/3' uses; uncommon (not owned) shop-link points to /neoshop?tab=baits; selecting common bait called select_fishing_bait once with _bait='bait_common'.

checks.name: fishing-collection-sheet-mocked
checks.evidence: All 5 fish cards (kuestenbarsch, sonnenbarsch, neon_makrele, palmenschnapper, leonida_marlin) rendered; caught fish shows 'Gefangen: 5x' style count; uncaught (sonnenbarsch) shows 'not caught' text + silhouette image class; legendary card has .fishing-crown element attached.

checks.name: neoshop-baits-tab-purchase-mocked
checks.evidence: /neoshop?tab=baits shows 5 bait cards with prices 12/25/50/87/125; buy dialog shows price '25', rarity, '+300%' bonus text, '3' uses, balance '1,000'; confirm called buy_fishing_bait exactly once with a string/number _nonce. Fixed mock payload shape (added 'charged'/'uses_left') after a console pageerror surfaced from an incomplete initial mock - not an app bug (see notes).

checks.name: neoshop-bait-insufficient-balance-mocked
checks.evidence: With mocked balance=5, buy dialog for legendary bait (125 coins) shows 'neoshop-bait-insufficient' alert, no confirm button present (count=0), 'Coins sammeln' (earn) link shown instead.

checks.criterion: Regression: vehicle design purchase deducts coins once
checks.name: neoshop-purchase-deducts-coins-once-mocked

checks.criterion: Regression: insufficient coins dialog for vehicle design
checks.name: neoshop-insufficient-coins-dialog-mocked

notes: neoshop-baits-tab-purchase-mocked initially logged a page console error (Cannot read properties of undefined reading 'toLocaleString') because my first mock for buy_fishing_bait omitted the 'charged' field that BaitShop.tsx's success toast reads (fmt(r.charged)). This was a test-mock shape gap, not an app bug — fixed the mock to include charged/uses_left and the check passed cleanly with no console errors on rerun. Flagging only so the real RPC's response shape (must include charged, balance, uses_left, already_processed per src/lib/fishing.ts useBuyBait) is kept in sync once SQL 027 is applied for real.

Playwright's default .click() actionability wait can stall for seconds on the pulsing gold reel button (continuous CSS transform animation never reports 'stable'); using click({force:true}) is required for the reel button in automated checks. Not an app bug — purely a headless-testing timing note for future checks on this screen.

A pre-existing check 'leonida-fishing-full-game-flow' (from an earlier iteration) targets the OLD fishing UI (fishing-start-overlay, canvas game, 45s round) that predates this v2 redesign (bait shop, cast/bite/reel RPC flow). It was left untouched/not rerun since it is outside this iteration's acceptance matrix and no longer reflects the current spec; it should be considered superseded.

Real-DB play remains impossible until the user runs docs/migrations/027_leonida_fishing_v2.sql on the live Supabase project (confirmed via briefing); all fishing UI criteria were verified with Playwright route mocks per the given fake-session pattern.
